name: @ship/studio
description: Sail Studio — activity rail and editor workspace. Surfaces: Edit · Components · Themes · Tasks · Config. Checks is a shell panel.

scripts.dev: cd ../.. && cargo run -q -p deck-cli --bin sail -- dev --project apps/studio --addr ${STUDIO_ADDR:-127.0.0.1:7891}
scripts.build: cd ../.. && cargo run -q -p deck-cli --bin sail -- build --project apps/studio --base assets
